name: AutoCorrect
description: The AutoCorrect object represents the AutoCorrect functionality of Microsoft Access.
remarks: To return an AutoCorrect object, use the AutoCorrect property. To enable or disable the display of the AutoCorrect Options button, use the DisplayAutoCorrectOptions property. To enable or disable AutoCorrect functionality for a particular TextBox or ComboBox object, use the AllowAutoCorrect property.

properties.name: DisplayAutoCorrectOptions
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that specifies whether the AutoCorrect Options button is displayed for the specified control. The default value is True. Read/write.
